organiser.name: Burt Munro Challenge (created by Southland Motorcycle Club; enquiries via a Great South address)

ticket_price.note: Spectator tickets $20 per race event ($10 with a General Rally Pass); General Rally Pass $90; All Access Rally Pass $140. From the official FAQ as crawled Oct 2026; edition not stated on the page.

add_sources.note: IG profile links burtmunrochallenge.co.nz; site shows 10 to 14 Feb 2027.
Southland Honda Track Day opened the 2026 event on Wed 4 Feb 2026; final-day post (https://www.instagram.com/p/DUd0vzzEtdc/) published 8 Feb NZDT. AMCN also says 4 to 8 Feb 2026 (Google snippet).
Official site: '10-14 FEBRUARY 2027' with full 2027 schedule; IG calls it the 20th Burt Munro Challenge (https://www.instagram.com/p/DepmV64F7lN/).
'the Southland Motorcycle Club created the Burt Munro Challenge'; inaugural event 2006.
Contact email is burtmunro@greatsouth.nz (Great South, Southland's regional development agency).
Contact page: Burt Munro Challenge, PO Box 1339, Invercargill; burtmunro@greatsouth.nz (general enquiries). No sponsorship-specific contact.
'ALL ACCESS Rally Pass: $140'; 'GENERAL Rally Pass: $90 ... ($10 instead of $20 per race event)'.

Footer sponsor logos on the site promoting the 2027 event: Shelley Henderson, Indian Motorcycle, Southland Honda, Southern Dragways, Craigs, Southland Motorcycle Club, Invercargill City Council, Star Insurance, Jack Daniel's, ILT Foundation, E Hayes, Great South. 2027 schedule keeps naming partners (Southland Honda Track Day, Star Insure Hill Climb, Indian Motorcycle Twilight Drags, E Hayes & Sons Beach Racing and Teretonga Sprints, Super Seller Shelley Speedway).
2026 final day: 'E Hayes & Sons Teretonga Sprint Races and Star Insurance NZ Superbike Champs'.
2026 raffle of a $40k Yamaha R6 race bike: 'Shout out to Yamaha Motor New Zealand ... the amazing sponsors who made the prize a reality'.
Jan 2026: 'Swipe to see each event and its partner'; each race event carries a sponsor name.

notes: 2026 dates resolved to 4 to 8 Feb from the organiser's own IG posts. Sponsorship model is naming rights on each race event (Honda, Star Insure, Indian, E Hayes, Shelley Henderson), so an open, sellable structure. Footer-logo sponsors are dated 2027 because the site now promotes the 2027 event; they may also have backed 2026. Ambassador Cormac Buchanan (Moto3 rider) not added as a sponsor. Organiser left vague: Southland Motorcycle Club founded it and Great South handles enquiries; orchestrator may want to confirm who runs it now.
